brand.footerLine: Celebrating People, One Gift at a Time

promiseCards.title: Issue protection

promiseCards.title: Clear order ID

paymentSteps: Payment success ke baad UTR / transaction reference enter karein.
Order place karein. Bank credit verify hone ke baad processing start hogi.
checkout.policyConsent: Main samajhta/samajhti hoon ki COD available nahi hai aur personalized/customized order par normal change-of-mind return apply nahi hota. Eligible wrong, damaged ya defective item ke verified claim par refund ya replacement protection milegi. Dispatch se pehle complete packing video share kiya jayega.

policy.title: Payment se pehle rules clear rakhein.
policy.lead: Order place karne se pehle payment, customization, packing aur issue-protection ki important terms clearly dikhayi jaati hain.

cards.title: Payment
cards.body: Orders prepaid hain. COD available nahi hai. UPI reference/UTR submit karne ke baad actual bank credit verify hone par hi payment confirmed maana jayega.

cards.title: Customized orders
cards.body: Personalized/customized hamper aapki instructions ke hisaab se banaya jata hai, isliye normal change-of-mind return apply nahi hota.

cards.title: Wrong / damaged / defective
cards.body: Eligible verified issue par refund ya replacement protection available hai. Claim review ke liye relevant evidence manga ja sakta hai.

cards.title: Packing video
cards.body: Dispatch se pehle packed hamper ka video share kiya jayega, taaki aap contents aur presentation dekh saken.

cards.title: Product substitutions
cards.body: Stock, size ya presentation constraint ke kaaran major equivalent substitution chahiye ho to customer confirmation ke bina nahi kiya jayega.

cards.title: Required delivery date
cards.body: Aapki selected date requirement ke roop me capture hoti hai. Final feasibility pincode, courier serviceability aur preparation time confirm hone ke baad committed maani jayegi.

seo.title: Celebration | Custom Gift Hampers
seo.description: Build personalized Celebration gift hampers for birthdays, anniversaries, festivals and special moments.

issues.title: Order me issue hai? Yahin report karein
issues.body: Wrong, damaged, defective ya missing item ke liye issue submit karein. Team verification ke baad eligible refund/replacement process start hoga.
issues.submitted: Issue submit ho gaya. Team review karegi.
